Shinda Creedpike is an Arathi located in Church of the Sacred Flame in Hallowfall. He used to fish with his mother at the local pond when he was a child. Over the years, he became a paladin and a lieutenant in the Arathi army, serving under Endiri Dawnsurge. When the adventurers of the Alliance and Horde arrived in Hallowfall, Endiri gave his soldiers a day off. When Shinda failed to report for his shift the next day, Endiri requested to find and bring him back. The reason for that was that he felt hollow and his sense of duty wavered.
